Sometimes you don’t need more answers. You need to ask yourself better questions. 🧠✨

Take a few minutes today to slow down, get quiet, and check in with yourself.

You might be surprised by what comes up when you stop looking outside yourself for the answer.

Which question made you stop and think? 👇

Your morning routine might be sabotaging your productivity before your day even starts. 📱🧠

The second you open your phone, you’re letting other people’s priorities, notifications, and noise into your brain before you’ve had a chance to focus on your own.

Try this instead: give yourself a little time in the morning before you reach for your phone.

Protect your attention. Protect your energy. And start your day on your terms. ✨

Could you go phone-free for the first 30 minutes of your day? 👇

Outside of work? 😂

I like to dance, laugh, play, explore, and enjoy the heck out of this wild little life. 💃✨

Because building a meaningful business matters to me, but so does having a life I actually love living.

Reminder: You’re allowed to be more than what you do for work. ❤️

What’s your favorite thing to do when you’re not working? 👇

Let's bust a few myths that might be keeping you stuck. 🧠

Sometimes the thing standing between you and your goals isn't a lack of ability. It's what you believe is possible.

We all pick up beliefs along the way that sound like facts, until we question them. A little perspective shift can open up a whole new set of possibilities. ✨

Which belief are you ready to question? 👇

Excuse me… WHAT?! 😉

Before B-School, Sarah Hawkey was running around NYC piecing together voice lesson gigs, calling it a side hustle. Now she runs a real business. This is her story, in her own words.

When your income more than doubles, it's definitely worth celebrating. But the number isn't the whole story.

Behind that kind of growth is someone who decided to bet on their ideas, learn what they didn't know, and actually take action.

Because building a business isn't just about making more money. It's about building the skills, confidence, and belief in yourself to create something that can grow.

And sometimes the results are so good you have to do a double take. 👀

💬 Want the details on B-School? Comment BSCHOOL below and I'll send them straight to your DMs. 👇

Growing up, fitting in felt like the only option. 🤝

But hiding parts of myself hurt more than I ever let on.

Carissa Schumacher put it perfectly in our conversation: you are not an a la carte menu, picking which pieces of yourself are safe to show and which ones need to stay hidden.

Let's embrace our entire selves, and support each other as whole people. ❤️

Comment CARISSA and I'll send you the full episode.

I didn’t start out knowing exactly what I was doing. 😂

I bartended while building my coaching business. I tried different careers. I took plenty of wrong turns.

And guess what?

Some things worked. Some things didn’t.

But I kept going.

Because failure isn’t proof that you should stop. It’s proof you’re in the game. 🎯

You don’t have to know exactly where you’re going to take the first step.

You just have to be willing to be a beginner. ❤️

And if you’re ready to start building a business of your own, I’d love to show you what’s possible.

💬 What's one thing you've been afraid to start because you might fail?

You don’t have to put yourself in a box just because the world wants to know “What do you do?” 😉

You can be an entrepreneur and a writer.
A coach and a creative.
A leader and a student.
A million things in between.

Your different interests, talents, and passions don’t have to compete with each other.

They can become the thing that makes your work uniquely yours. ✨

So, fellow multipassionate person: stop trying to pick just one. ❤️

What are the different things you’re passionate about? 👇

Procrastination isn’t always about being lazy or lacking discipline. 😬

Sometimes, it’s fear in disguise. 👀

Fear of getting it wrong.
Fear of being judged.
Fear of putting yourself out there.
Fear of finding out you’re not as good as you hoped.

So you stall. You scroll. You find one more thing to do first. 📱

But the way through isn’t waiting until the fear disappears.

It’s taking the next step anyway. 💪✨

What have you been putting off because, deep down, you’re a little afraid? 👇

Feeling overwhelmed? 😵‍💫

Before you download another productivity app or add another “life hack” to your routine, look at your calendar. 👀

Ask yourself:

✨ What can I eliminate?
✨ What can I automate?
✨ What can I delegate?
✨ What actually deserves my best energy?
✨ What needs a “not now” instead of a “yes”?

Because productivity isn’t about squeezing more into your day.

It’s about creating more freedom in your life. 💫

That's the heart of Time Genius.
And if you grab it before tomorrow at 7pm ET, you'll save $500!
Which one of these questions do you need to ask yourself this week? 👇

Not everything worth paying for has to make you more money.

Some investments pay you back in clarity, confidence, health, time, and freedom.

For me, these are the ones that keep paying dividends long after the initial investment:

Therapy or coaching.✨
Books that change how you think. 📚
Your health.🧠
Education that expands your earning potential.🏫
Anything that buys your time back.⏰

The goal isn’t to spend more. It’s to spend intentionally on the things that help you build a bigger, better, freer life.

⭐ What’s the best investment you’ve ever made in yourself?
